questions.explanation: The price effect measures the overall effect that a change in the price of a commodity has on the consumer's purchase quantity of that commodity. There is not compensatory change in the income of the consumer under the price effect. When there is a decrease or increase in the price of a commodity. the satisfaction of the consumer will also change. That is, if the price of the commodity falls, it will be on the higher indifference curve and if the price of the commodity increases, it will move to the lower indifference curve due to this.
